We are to implement the outgoing version of the Triangle Multiplicative Update (TriMul) operator from AlphaFold3. The input tensor has shape [B, N, N, C]. The operation involves four main steps:  
1. Layer normalization of the input.  
2. Linear projections (left_proj, right_proj, and gates).  
3. Masking and gating (element-wise multiplication).  
4. The core contraction: for each batch and channel, compute a matrix multiplication between two matrices obtained from the projected input.  

This operation is O(N³) due to the summation over the sequence dimension (N), which is very expensive for large N values. Triton allows fine-grained parallelization and efficient memory accesses, making it suitable to optimize this.
